1. The present petition is filed under section 482 Cr.P.C. for quashing of FIR bearing no.0198/2021 dated 08.04.2021 registered under sections 498A/406/34 IPC at P.S. Dwarka North along with consequential judicial proceedings.
2. Issue notice.

3. Mr. Utkarsh, Additional Public Prosecutor assisted by the Investigating Officer SI Bhoop Singh,
P.S. Dwarka North, accepts notice on behalf of the respondent no.1/State.
The respondent no.2 is present in person along with the counsel and accepts notice.

5. The respondent no.2 due to matrimonial differences, filed petition under section 12 of the Protection of Women from Domestic Violence Act, 2005 stated to be pending before the court of Ms.
Divya Yadav, MM (Mahila Court), Dwarka Courts, Delhi.

sentences.text: The petitioner no. 1 also filed a petition under sections 7 and 25 of the Guardians and Wards Act, 1890 bearing no. 48/2020 titled as Dheeraj Vats V Richa Vats.
It is stated that these petitions have already been disposed of/withdrawn by the concerned parties.

6. The respondent no. 2 also lodged complaint before CAW Cell, Dwarka, which culminated into registration of FIR bearing no.0198/2021 under sections 406/498A/34 IPC at P.S. Dwarka North wherein the petitioners were implicated.

After conclusion of investigation, the charge- sheet was filed and the trial is stated to be pending in the court of Ms. Divya Yadav, MM (Mahila Court),
Dwarka Courts, Delhi/Successor Court.
The mother of the petitioner no. 1, who was also implicated in the said FIR is stated to be expired on 18.07.2023.
The petitioners no.2 to 6 are the family members/relatives of the petitioner no.1.
The petitioners and the respondent no. 2 are identified by the Investigating Officer SI Bhoop Singh, P.S. Dwarka North as well as by their respective counsel.
7. The petition under sections 7 and 25 of the Guardians and Wards Act, 1890 bearing no. 48/2020 was referred to Counselling Cell for settlement.

The petitioner no.1 and the respondent no.2 have settled their disputes vide Settlement dated 20.07.2022 recorded before Principal Counsellor, Dwarka Courts, Delhi

whereby they have agreed to dissolve their marriage by way of mutual consent as per section 13B of the Hindu Marriage Act,
1955.

The petitioner no.1 has agreed to pay Rs.18,00,000/- (Rupees Eighteen Lacs Only) to the respondent no.2 towards full and final satisfaction of her claims/legal entitlements (past, present and future) arising out of marriage between the petitioner no.1 and the respondent no.2 including permanent alimony/maintenance/istridhan etc. and other miscellaneous and legal expenses.

It is stated that the petitioner no.1 has already paid the entire settled amount to the respondent no.2,
which is acknowledged by the respondent no.2.
8.

The marriage between the petitioner no.1 and the respondent no.2 has been dissolved by way of decree of divorce by mutual consent as per section 13B (2) of the Hindu Marriage Act, 1955 by the court of Mr. Vipin Kumar Rai, Principal Judge, Family Courts-01, Dwarka Courts, Delhi vide judgment dated 22.07.2023 in petition bearing HMA no. 2372/2023 titled as Richa Vats and Dheeraj Vats.
9.

The Additional Public Prosecutor stated that the petitioner no.1 and the respondent no.2 have already settled their disputes vide Settlement dated 20.07.2022 and their marriage has already been dissolved as such, he does not have any objection if the present petition is allowed and FIR bearing no.0198/2021 is quashed along with consequential judicial proceedings but he expressed his concern regarding one minor child, namely, Yudhveer Vats in view of the judgment titled as Ganesh V Sudhir Kumar Shrivastava and Ors. Yudhveer Vats relating to maintenance and other issues.
12.
